narrative.headline: 2019 Ram 1500: electrical and steering top the complaint list
narrative.summary: From 1,437 owner complaints to NHTSA, the two biggest trouble spots are the electrical system (364 reports, 25%) and steering (326 reports, 23%) - together nearly half of everything filed. Engine (221) and power train (200) issues follow. Service brakes draw fewer reports (127) but the highest crash count of any area (15). Several categories include fires and injuries, so check the breakdown before you buy.

issues.title: Electrical System
issues.blurb: The single most-reported problem: 364 complaints (25%). Tied to 4 fires, 7 crashes, and 5 injuries - watch for warning lights, electronics that quit, and sensor faults.
